item.title: Man and woman reported missing out of Saratoga Springs since Thursday
item.description: Police are seeking information about a man and a woman who have been reported missing and are believed to be on their way to California.

item.title: Discover long-lost relatives at genealogy event sponsored by Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints
item.description: Have you ever wondered where you come from, where your family came from. or whether you are in some way distantly related to people you pass on the street? RootsTech 2026 might just be the place to start to find those answers.

item.title: New 'Constitutional Court' trigger law proposed in response to three-judge panel challenges at Utah Supreme Court
item.description: A new law allowing the state to move cases from district-level judges to a three-judge panel is undergoing significant changes at the Utah legislature, including a trigger provision that will revert the panel to a "Constitutional Court" if the law is enjoined.

item.title: Two ejected from vehicle after hitting cow on EB I-80 near Coalville
item.description: Two people were ejected from a vehicle and injured after striking a cow on eastbound I-80 near Coalville.

item.title: Bureau of Land Management approves Pine Valley pipeline project amid mixed reactions
item.description: This week, the Bureau of Land Management (BLM) approved a water pipeline project in Pine Valley, Utah, leading to mixed reactions from local organizations and government officials.

item.title: 'You never expect to be saying goodbye this soon': Idaho state police K-9 Kimber retires after being diagnosed with cancer
item.description: An explosive detection K-9 with the Idaho State Police named Kimber has retired after she was recently diagnosed with cancer.

item.title: SONIC goes green for St. Patrick's Day with new Sour Shamrock Slush
item.description: SONIC drive-thru has announced the arrival of its new SONIC Sour Shamrock Slush just in time for St. Patrick's Day.

item.title: Traffic Alert: Van Winkle Expressway closed at 5600 S due to crash
item.description: Van Winkle Expressway is closed to all traffic at 5600 South in Holladay due to a crash.

item.title: 2 men charged with over a dozen felonies each following drug bust in Tooele
item.description: Two men living in the same house have been charged with more than a dozen felonies each after a search warrant was served following a nearly yearlong investigation.

item.title: Local bar discusses safety after fight breaks out nearby
item.description: A new bar in Salt Lake City is discussing safety concerns after a group fight broke out in front of their business.
